title: Show HN: Keen Bean – Mac meeting notes that draft the spec while you talk
summary: Keen Bean is a macOS meeting notes application that uses AI to automatically draft technical specifications in real-time during meetings, eliminating the need for manual documentation while allowing users to focus on the conversation.
problem_solved: Reduces the burden of manual meeting documentation by automatically generating specs and notes while discussions are happening
why_valuable: Saves significant time on post-meeting documentation and ensures no critical details are missed during important discussions
